title: Look up a ticker and view its quote panel
description: Verifies that a user can search for a ticker in the command center and see the quote panel for that symbol.

steps.description: Navigate to /command-center
Enter a valid ticker symbol in the search field
Search for the ticker
Verify the ticker quote panel is displayed

title: View portfolio summary and holdings on the dashboard
description: Verifies that a user can open the dashboard and inspect portfolio summary metrics and holdings.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Verify portfolio summary metrics are displayed
Verify holdings are displayed

title: Log a trade from command center
description: Verifies that a user can search for a ticker, open the trade ticket, and submit a journal entry from the analysis workspace.

steps.description: Navigate to /command-center
Enter a valid ticker symbol in the search field
Search for the ticker
Open the trade ticket drawer
Submit a journal entry
Verify the trade is recorded in the workflow

title: Run deep analysis for a searched ticker
description: Verifies that a user can search for a ticker and launch deep analysis to view the analysis results for that symbol.

steps.description: Navigate to /command-center
Enter a valid ticker symbol in the search field
Search for the ticker
Run deep analysis for the selected ticker
Verify the analysis results are displayed

title: Review today overview and open a linked workflow
description: Verifies that a user can review the today queue and continue into a related workflow from an actionable card.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify today action cards are displayed
Click a card link to continue to a related workflow
Verify the related workflow page is displayed

title: Review ticker quote and decision packet
description: This test verifies that a user can open a ticker detail page and review the quote data and decision packet for that symbol.

steps.description: Navigate to /market
Open an item in the explorer
Open the related ticker detail view
Verify quote information is shown for the selected ticker
Verify a decision packet is displayed

title: Chat about a ticker in command center
description: Verifies that a user can search for a ticker, switch to chat mode, and see a response in the chat thread.

steps.description: Navigate to /command-center
Enter a valid ticker symbol in the search field
Search for the ticker
Switch to chat workspace mode
Send a message about the ticker
Verify a chat response is displayed

title: Log a new trade from the journal
description: Verifies that a user can open the trade drawer, submit a new trade, and see it added to journal history.

steps.description: Navigate to /journal
Open the log trade drawer
Fill in valid trade details
Submit the trade
Verify the new trade appears in the journal history

title: Browse journal history and filter trades
description: Verifies that a user can open the trade journal and filter or sort the history to find previous trades.

steps.description: Navigate to /journal
Apply a trade filter
Change the trade sort order
Verify journal entries are displayed
Verify the filtered journal view is displayed

title: Add a ticker to the watchlist from the dashboard
description: Verifies that a user can add a new ticker to the watchlist and see it appear in the dashboard list.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Add a new ticker to the watchlist
Verify the watchlist is displayed
Verify the new watchlist ticker is displayed

title: Filter and inspect journal entries
description: Verifies that a trader can narrow the journal by common filters and see the trade list update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /journal
Filter the journal by a ticker
Filter the journal by a trade mode
Filter the journal by a trade status
Verify the trade list is narrowed to matching entries

title: Inspect ticker journal history and analysis context
description: This test verifies that a user can open a ticker detail page and inspect its journal history and analysis context.

steps.description: Navigate to /market
Open an item in the explorer
Open the related ticker detail view
Verify journal history is displayed
Verify analysis context is displayed

title: Open ticker detail from a linked workflow
description: Verifies that a user can navigate into a ticker detail view from an existing workflow and inspect the ticker context.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Open a ticker detail view from a linked ticker
Verify the ticker detail view is displayed
Verify ticker context content is displayed

title: View analytics metrics and equity curve
description: Verifies that an investor can open analytics and review the core performance summary and equity curve.

steps.description: Navigate to /analytics
Verify analytics metric cards are displayed
Verify an equity curve chart is displayed

title: Remove a ticker from the watchlist on the dashboard
description: Verifies that a user can remove an existing ticker from the watchlist and see it disappear from the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Remove a ticker from the watchlist
Verify the watchlist is displayed
Verify the removed ticker is no longer displayed

title: Continue from ticker detail into related workflow
description: This test verifies that a user can move from ticker detail into a related analysis or journal workflow and keep the ticker context.

steps.description: Navigate to /market
Open an item in the explorer
Open the related ticker detail view
Continue into a related analysis or journal workflow
Verify the related workflow is displayed
Verify the selected ticker context remains visible

title: Expand a journal row to inspect trade details
description: Verifies that a user can expand a trade row in the journal and inspect the associated details.

steps.description: Navigate to /journal
Expand a journal row
Verify the row details are displayed

title: Use ticker detail from a linked workflow
description: This test verifies that a user can reach ticker detail from an app workflow and review the full ticker context there.

steps.description: Navigate to /market
Open an item in the explorer
Open the related ticker detail view
Verify the ticker detail page is displayed
Verify quote information, decision packet, and journal context are available

title: Refresh today queue and see updated actions
description: Verifies that refreshing the today overview updates the action list and statuses in the page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Refresh the today queue
Verify the today action cards are displayed
Verify the status indicators are displayed

title: Sort journal trades and review the updated order
description: Verifies that a user can sort the trade journal columns and observe the row order change.

steps.description: Navigate to /journal
Sort the journal by a trade column
Sort the journal by another trade column
Verify the trade rows are displayed in the updated order

title: Browse market themes and compare quotes
description: This test verifies that a user can explore market themes on the market explorer and review display-only quote data to compare ideas.

steps.description: Navigate to /market
Browse a market sector or theme section
Open an item in the explorer
Verify display-only quote data is shown
Verify market theme or sector information is shown

title: Review analytics after journaling trades
description: Verifies that a user can open analytics and see performance metrics and the equity curve derived from journal history.

steps.description: Navigate to /analytics
Verify performance metrics are displayed
Verify the equity curve is displayed

title: Expand a journal row to review trade details
description: Verifies that expanding a trade row reveals the full trade detail information for review.

steps.description: Navigate to /journal
Expand a trade row
Verify the trade detail information is visible

title: Open related ticker detail from market exploration
description: This test verifies that a user can move from market exploration into a related ticker detail view and see the ticker context load.

steps.description: Navigate to /market
Open an item in the explorer
Open the related ticker detail view
Verify the ticker detail page is displayed
Verify quote information is shown for the selected ticker

title: Open a related workflow from a dashboard quick action
description: Verifies that a user can jump from the dashboard into a related analysis or journaling workflow using a quick action.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Use a quick action to open a related workflow
Verify the related workflow page is displayed

title: Filter analytics by date and mode
description: Verifies that a user can adjust analytics filters and see the performance view refresh accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /analytics
Apply a date filter
Apply a trade mode filter
Verify the analytics metrics and chart are updated

title: Inspect market explorer sectors and themes
description: Verifies that a user can open the market explorer and browse sector or theme content with displayed quote data.

steps.description: Navigate to /market
Browse a sector or theme view
Verify market quote data is displayed
Verify sector or theme content is displayed

title: Review portfolio risk and scenario planning
description: Verifies that a user can open the risk page and inspect concentration metrics and scenario planning context.

steps.description: Navigate to /risk
Verify portfolio concentration metrics are displayed
Verify scenario planning content is displayed

title: Open ticker detail from a journal entry
description: Verifies that a user can move from a journal row into the linked ticker detail view.

steps.description: Navigate to /journal
Open a ticker link from a journal row
Verify the ticker detail page is displayed

title: Open command center from a journal entry
description: Verifies that a user can move from a journal row into the linked command center analysis workspace.

steps.description: Navigate to /journal
Open a command center link from a journal row
Verify the command center page is displayed

title: Browse config sections and save preference changes
description: Verifies that a user can navigate configuration sections, edit preferences, and save changes successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /config
Open a settings section
Edit a preference field
Save the configuration changes
Verify the updated settings are visible

title: Persist configuration changes after revisiting the page
description: Verifies that saved preference changes remain in place when the configuration page is revisited.

steps.description: Navigate to /config
Change a runtime preference value
Save the configuration changes
Navigate to /config
Verify the updated preference remains visible

title: Handle an empty ticker search in command center
description: Verifies that the command center shows validation feedback when a user searches without entering a ticker.

steps.description: Navigate to /command-center
Submit the ticker search without entering a symbol
Verify a search validation error is displayed

title: Reject an invalid watchlist ticker on the dashboard
description: Verifies that the dashboard prevents adding an invalid ticker and shows validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Add an invalid ticker to the watchlist
Verify a watchlist validation error is displayed

title: Handle an invalid journal trade entry
description: Verifies that the journal prevents submitting an invalid trade and shows validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /journal
Open the log trade drawer
Enter an invalid trade entry
Submit the trade entry
Verify a trade validation error is displayed
